text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, as I passed by the Director's office, I heard Chairwoman Akikawa's voice coming from behind the door.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Alright! ...No, thank you as well for all your hard work, Tazuna. Finally... it's finally time...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, you!
Rejoice... The event preparations are finally mostly complete.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm...! I'm truly looking forward
to the day itself...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Haha, no, no. Having cleared the hardest part,
I suppose I let my guard down a little.
That won't do. The real deal is still to come...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Can you not picture it clearly?
The students... rejoicing...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"—Chairwoman? Chairwoman!?
Oh no, this is terrible!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: The Chairwoman... collapsed!?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
She's laid up in the nurse's office right now...?
Is she gonna be okay?!
choice_data_list: They said it was probably overwork, but...
They said it was probably overwork, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...You were already busy enough as it is,
yet you still helped with event preparations... and even the field work, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"The Chairwoman... she really pushed herself
to the absolute limit for us, didn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: For our sake—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Madam Chairwoman.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...I want you all to keep having fun running forever.
That might just be my own ego talking, though..."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...It was also my one and only dream.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
choice_data_list: ...Now is the time to repay the favor!
...Now is the time to repay the favor!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. We might've only thought of the event day itself, but all the students have been preparing all along.
...We can do this, right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Of course! If I don't give it my all right now,
when am I ever gonna do it?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"It was still in the prototype phase, but...
with everyone's feelings united, we'll make it work somehow!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All right! I'll go call the others over!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Mmh! This carrot... its fighting spirit is different!
It will surely nourish the Chairwoman!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
This potato over here is huge too!
This'll give us energy! Let's dig 'em all up together!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Spe, Trainer, grab that side!
Here we go, one, two, heave!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ready, aaand!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Right. Even back during our first training camp...
the Chairwoman lent a helping hand, didn't she?)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(I'll never forget the taste of the meal we shared...!
Please wait for me... Chairwoman!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hmph! Special Move: Garlic Mash!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
O-Over here,
I finished peeling the carrots and potatoes!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
First, prep the carrots, and...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Leave the vegetable chopping to me!
Rice will chop, chop, chop away!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Feel free to toss the chopped veggies right into the pot~!
I'll cook them all up together~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: (Cooking that makes both heart and body buono! Time to pay back the Chairwoman~!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Thanks to the Chairwoman, we were able
to learn so, so much about food...!)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(The Chairwoman was thinking of us
the whole time...!)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(I have to tell her...!
I have to tell the Chairwoman...!)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: (Our feelings... the feelings of everyone!)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Chairwoman, you've regained consciousness!?
Thank goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Tazuna... I see.
Did I... collapse?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief, my body just won't get up right now. After telling the students to stay healthy and full of energy, how pathetic of me... haha.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It's because you pushed yourself too hard.
...No matter how many times I tell you,
you just won't listen.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Attending the Great Harvest Festival might be... a bit
tricky. However... the preparations are complete."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
This is fine. I have created an opportunity for the students
to experience wonderful cuisine. I am... satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...... The Chairwoman certainly is that kind of person, isn't she?
...However.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...The students will surely be sad
if you're unable to show your face, Chairwoman.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um... Chairwoman, are you there?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mmh...! ...Tazuna.
Help me sit up.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Chairwoman... Are you feeling alright?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry.
I'm well enough to stand right up like this!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Still... it might be tough for me to take the lead
in managing things on the day. I'll probably have to rely
on you guys and Tazuna... Sorry about that."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Madam Chairwoman. Actually...
there's something I'd like you to have.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...? Come to think of it, I've noticed something...
smelling unusually good for a while now—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"What an extravagant meal!
Did you two really make all this...?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I know your body hurts right now, but...
Um, just take a single bite, okay?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...All right. I shall gladly savor it!
And not just one bite, but two or three!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
(That said... the way I am now,
I wonder if I can even properly taste it...)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for the meal!
......

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Soooo goooood!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Wha, what is this flavor!?
It's like an electric shock—
vitality has returned throughout my entire body...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I can attend... I can totally attend!
Attending the Great Harvest Festival is a piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
R-Really!? ...Thank goodness...!
I'm so... so glad...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Profoundly moved, I am! Thank you...!
To think the students themselves would prepare such an exquisite feast for the Grand Harvest Festival!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...The thing is... this dish is different.
It wasn't made for the Great Harvest Festival.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I made this dish
specifically for the Chairwoman."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That's right. After countless discussions and
combining our efforts—
we finally arrived at this recipe.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
W-What... No way...!?
You're all doing this... for me...?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It's not just us~! It's everyone—all the students!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"We discussed and decided on both the ingredients and the cooking method, right?
Man... I was so nervous that the Chairwoman might find out."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"The Chairwoman told us, remember?
That her only wish is for Rice and everyone else
to keep running in good health."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: That's why Rice and the others felt the same way.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"For the Chairwoman to stay happy and healthy forever.
That's our wish."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
“...... Tazuna.
Right now, I have an intense urge... to be alone.”

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"I feel as though I won't be able to stop...
the tears from flowing in front of the students."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...I really think it would be better to show them.
